# mtncloud_cluster_type (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud cluster type source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_cluster_type" "kubernetes_layout" {
  name = "Kubernetes Cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud cluster type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
